create_custom_wrapper: create a custom AndroidEnv wrapper by subclassing BaseWrapper and overriding _process_action and _process_timestep
reset_wrapped_env: reset a wrapped AndroidEnv instance and get the initial timestep from the underlying environment
step_wrapped_env: step a wrapped AndroidEnv with an action that gets processed before being forwarded to the underlying env
save_load_state: save and load the state of a wrapped AndroidEnv using protobuf SaveStateRequest and LoadStateRequest
get_raw_env: get the unwrapped raw AndroidEnv interface by accessing the raw_env property on a wrapped instance
